summary: Tested the admin seed and dashboard login, backend and frontend. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (13 new in test_admin_seed.py, plus the test_feed_posts.py regression), run serially with -n 0. Covered: admin login returns role=admin and no password field. Wrong password gives 401. The stored hash is bcrypt $2b$. /api/admin/stats, /users and /posts return 200 for the admin. For maria (migrant) all three return 403, and with no token the request is rejected. Restarting the backend through supervisor leaves exactly 1 admin document and login still works. When the admin's password and role were changed in the DB, a restart put both back (same user id, no duplicate). Frontend: admin logged in at /auth, then /admin showed the stats overview (3 users, 12 posts, 11 messages); the Usuários tab lists the 3 users and the Publicações tab lists the posts. No page errors and no API calls at 4xx/5xx. Maria's feed at /home shows 10 post cards, she has no Admin nav item, and visiting /admin redirects her to /home.

minor.issue: Email matching is case-sensitive. seed_admin lowercases ADMIN_EMAIL, but login does not normalize the email, so 'Admin@fieledeus.com' gets 401. Register also stores the email as typed.
No brute-force protection: 6 or more failed attempts all return 401 with no lockout. This was already the case.

action_items: Optional: lowercase and strip the email in /auth/login and /auth/register so they match the seeded admin email.
Optional: add login rate limiting or lockout, especially now that a known admin account exists.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True. Auth is a Bearer token, not cookies, so this is low risk, but it should use explicit origins.
Auth uses a Bearer JWT stored in localStorage, so no httpOnly cookies are set (a playbook check item does not apply).
If seed_admin raises (for example Mongo is unreachable), the whole startup fails because it is not wrapped in try/except, unlike the index creation.
The 'Adicionar Admin' button in the Users tab registers admins via /api/auth/register and then a role PUT. Review whether that path is admin-protected end to end (not tested here).
server.py is 2224 lines and AdminDashboard.js is 1514 lines; both should be split.
/app/auth_testing.md does not exist (the review request refers to it).
seed_data_creation: None new. test_seed_resets_changed_password_and_role temporarily changes the admin's password and role in the DB, then a backend restart restores them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests with `-n 0`. pytest.ini enables xdist, and the restart tests in test_admin_seed.py break parallel tests (502s). On /admin the tabs are Visão Geral, Usuários, Publicações, Hospedagem and Divulgações. The auth form may open in register mode; click toggle-auth-mode if name-input is visible.
